 JP Morgan, March 2022 to October 2025, Team lead 
➢ Fund Services (Trade capture and Validation) 
Key Roles and Responsibilities 
 
• Booking and Monitoring trades across multiple financial products including MBS, FX, 
Securities and Money Market instruments, strictly adhering to Client instructions to 
ensure flawless execution. 
• Processing trades via SWIFT messages and trade blotter instructions, ensuring accuracy 
and alignment with operational standards across global regions. 
• Conducting Proactive checks on failed and missing trades and take corrective actions 
promptly to minimize financial risk and maintain data integrity. 
• Resolving trade breaks on timely manner and escalate unresolved issues as needed to 
ensure Swift resolution. 
• Consistently meeting daily deliverables with a strong focus on precision and adherence to 
cut-off times, contributing to high client satisfaction and process reliability. 
• Addressing Client queries and executing trade bookings before regional cut-offs, 
maintaining service level agreements and operational excellence. 
• Ensure 100% accuracy & timeliness across trade lifecycle activities by effectively 
utilizing using VET & CSW tools, strengthening process integrity and client satisfaction. 
• Resolving High-Impact trade discrepancies and operational challenges, reducing 
turnaround time and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability 
within the team.

timely manner.
